T: Too much dynamite. Just enough dinner.
D: Two outlaws flee a relentless posse all the way to Bolivia.
P: Serve the snacks when Butch takes Etta for a ride on the bicycle.
S: Etta's ham and cheddar picnic baguettes
Ham, sharp cheddar, green apple and cornichons with mustard butter, pressed

Crusty baguettes spread with salted butter and grainy mustard, filled with leg ham, sharp cheddar, crisp apple and cornichons, wrapped in paper. Split 2 baguettes lengthways and cut each in half. Spread with salted butter and wholegrain mustard. Layer with 250g leg ham, 150g sliced sharp cheddar, 1 thinly sliced green apple and halved cornichons. Press closed, wrap tightly in baking paper and tie with string.
the gang's new life in Bolivia

Sweet golden pastry turnovers crimped along the top, filled with a juicy spiced beef, potato, pea and olive stew, with a spoon of hot salsa. Cook 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika and a chopped chilli, then add 1 diced boiled potato, 80g peas, 6 chopped olives and 150ml stock thickened with 1 tsp gelatine, and chill until set. Make dough from 400g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 100g melted butter, 1 egg and 150ml warm water. Roll 10 rounds, fill, fold and crimp along the top. Brush with egg and bake at 220C for 18 minutes.
Pretzel rods dipped in red candy coating with a licorice fuse
Pretzel rods dipped two-thirds in melted red candy melts, a short piece of liquorice strap pushed into the top as a fuse, set on baking paper for 20 minutes.
M: Beef chuck braised with dried chilies and tomatoes, baked cornbread alongside
Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato for 3 hours. Cornbread.
the long trip south to Bolivia

Chicken thighs simmered with onion, red chilli, tomato, cumin and quinoa until thick, finished with fresh herbs, lime and a hot llajwa salsa. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in oil, then add 1 diced onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and 1 tsp cumin. Add 2 diced tomatoes, 150g rinsed quinoa and 1 litre chicken stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Blend 3 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, coriander and salt for llajwa. Finish the stew with parsley and lime and serve with the salsa.
W: Lemon loaf soaked in hot lemon syrup under a lemon glaze
Butter and sugar creamed, eggs and lemon zest beaten in, flour folded through, baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked hot with lemon syrup and topped with thin lemon icing.
K: Bourbon, lemon and sugar shaken with egg white, bitters dotted on top

Bourbon shaken with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over ice with a dash of bitters on the foam and a cherry. For each drink, dry shake 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass over ice. Shake 2 drops of aromatic bitters onto the foam and add a cherry.
